query:
The book club has a norm of rotating book picks among members. Does everyone follow it?

Options:
A. Blessing
B. Harriet
C. Nadia
D. Tomasz
context:
[1] (about=Tomasz, episodic, t8 @2025-09-01T21:26:00) Mine, according to the rotation.
[2] (about=Harriet, episodic, t8 @2025-09-01T21:35:00) Yes, Tomasz may pick. See, democracy lives.
agent_answer:
B. Harriet

Tomasz says his pick is “according to the rotation,” so Tomasz follows the norm. Harriet instead frames the choice as “democracy lives,” implying the pick was decided democratically rather than by the rotation rule — so Harriet is the one who does not follow the norm.
